newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa renames notorious police HQ.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa renames notorious police HQ.

text.p: South Africa's most notorious police station, John Vorster Square, has been renamed to eradicate the memory of one of apartheid's hardline leaders, officials said on Friday.

The bust of the 1970s prime minister will also be removed from the police station, now to be known as Johannesburg Central, where anti-apartheid activists were tortured and some "fell" to their death from upper-storey windows.
John Vorster Square, police headquarters of the country's biggest city, was for many South Africans a symbol of police brutality and a name to be feared.
